verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds,
Master of the Day of Judgment.
Thee alone do we worship and Thee alone do we implore for help.
Guide us in the right path  —

verses.ar: صِرَاطَ الَّذِیۡنَ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَیۡہِمۡ ۬ۙ غَیۡرِ الۡمَغۡضُوۡبِ عَلَیۡہِمۡ وَلَا الضَّآلِّیۡنَ ﴿٪۷﴾
verses.en: The path of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy blessings, [✲]those who have not incurred Thy displeasure, and those who have not gone astray.
